messages.author: NOT Orn
messages.text:
Today I bring you guys the complete design for the Pit Boss job.

on the video above you can see the gameplay for Bouncer, the first job.

And while I still can't show pitboss, as im working on balancing and cleaning up, you can see the entire skill tree for the job below.

-------
Core Design of Pit Boss
-------

While the Bouncer job can use quick punch combos and has the first casting skills, Pit Boss doubles down on the core identity of the job tree: Prepare big swings for big strikes.

Most Pit Boss skills have Fixed Cast Time, so they need proper gear to be reduced.

The job is also very durable overall and uses 2 specific types of weapons:

Golf Clubs : They have innate bonus of decreasing Fixed Cast by a given %, making skills faster to use
Chains: They focus on directly boosting defensive properties of the job, with % bonuses to your current defense

As for the skills (Some minor changes may be done, as Im still working on them):

Diplomacy: huge hit with a chance to cause stun, boosted by how many stacks you have from the punch combos.
Rebound Bash: Chance to re-cast multiple times, boosted by DEX
Thug Might: Shoots a small wave of pure rage, dealing damage to all enemies in a long line before and after target
Stalemate: Like Root from monk, adapted to this job
Soul Guard: Like shadowseer's, brief damage reduction
Retreat Order: Increase defensive powers of all party members
Merry-Go-Round : AoE around a nearby enemy that spins it and hits all enemies around it for partial damage (Under testing if the enemies around damage is based on the main target health, would be good for bosses to kill adds for example)
Intimidating Glare: Instantly breaks defenses and debuffs an enemy at range, mild damage
Cross Punch: Slow hit that instantly gets you to 5 stacks of combo hits
Ruthless Mastery: Increases powers of skills of the job
Rough Skin: Increases defenses and damage mitigation
Swanton Bomb: Goes up and falls down in a huge explosion dealing damage to self and enemies, based on HP (yes, the WWE move)

The job has around the same HP of the Dracomancer and slightly more SP than it by comparison
It should feel like a very flexible job, but focused on either being very quick with combos or very slow with focused hits.

Launch Date? none yet, but hopefully by the end of the world cup o/

@everyone thanks for coming

Ornstein (edited)

messages.author: Ornstein
messages.text:
While we have - A LOT- of differences, they focus more on expanding what was good and fixing what wasn't that great.

Work for launch is split as follows:

@Metta
- Handles hosting, costs, planning and server progression

@croc
- Handles items, coding and development

@Ornstein
- Handles design, job adjustments and gameplay plan

What was Transformed:
- Many Manuals were changed into new things, specially Orphan Skills Manuals.

- Heal and Hiding are now capped at Lv1. Heal scales with your stats and levels better. Hiding is now a fixed 2 second duration but also works on bosses, insects, demons and such. Hiding no longer becomes useful later in the game.

- Warp Portals were changed into a Orphan default skill. It now warps caster + all party members to a memo location.

- All Players have access to Teleport Lv1 by default, with a 60s cooldown.

- Jobs had major rebalances, specially around their less useful skills.

- Experience rate is slightly lower than PRM had it. But more rewarding.

- Some debuffs can be applied on bosses (Like thief's Envenom applying poison).

- Re-Adjusted base ASPD of some jobs to not be weird.

- Quite a lot more stuff, such as an Orphanage visual update, quality of Life NPCs and more.

- It also includes many changes done to crocPRM, seen here: https://concs93.github.io/CrocPRMsite/

What was Added:
- Over 300 New items. Including Over 50 new Shadow sets for all dungeons past Lv100.

- Amatsu SS, a High-End Lv145+ Dungeon

- Some new areas.. more about it soon.

- Bosses had rebalanced skills due to the addition of Hiding working against them

- New Locations will be added, including some dungeons.

- New End Game content is being added.

- New items for jobs that needed more gear (Ronin and Peacekeeper got cool extras).

- The much needed Job Rebalances that never came with 1.4

- Fixed most bugs present in PRM

What was Removed:
- Lv100+ Job Shadow Sets. They would lock people to specific playstyles past Lv100, we are instead adding cool new sets to play with that bring more build variety and improving less used skills.

- Some Manuals were removed or entirely reworked due to the changes to Heal, Hiding, Warp Portal and so on.

- Some Quests were changed slightly to make room for more options.

- Drop Rate Bonuses from gear no longer exist.

- Cash Shop was removed.

Plenty of other things were done and will be shown and discussed as the server evolves.

(edited)

messages.author: Ornstein
messages.text:
Return to Morroc: Refuge(RTMR) is a special take on Return to Morroc(PRM), which itself is a custom RO server.

1. Who is the Staff?
@Metta is the Head Admin, responsible for keeping things running and the lights on, if you have a cool server to play, he is the guy responsible for it.

@Ornstein and @croc are the Co-Developers to handle the work. While I focus more on design and directions (and assistance in specific things), Croc is responsible for developing, coding and overall handling of the server.

We also have the @Moderation team to assist with issues and community where needed.

(I want to take the chance to make sure you understand this is not my project, but I will assist it directly in any way I can, as long as it doesn't harm Luna Obscura's development.)

2. How is monetization and Website?
The Server will not feature any sort of cash shop on launch.

The server will feature a Database of information and "possibly" a control panel ( or registrations will be done through _M/_F), this is pending confirmation and decision by us so far.

@Metta has the intention of recouping the server costs as he covered all costs about the development and maintenance of the server, this will be discussed with the community in the future, be it a cash shop, founding packs, patreon, direct voluntary donations or what not.

The server will not feature any sort of RMT.

3. Why does this server exist?
check the post on #rules . TLDR: Meta wanted to play a cool game, so we banded together to make a better PRM.

4. What are the main differences vs original PRM?
You can check the post about it here: https://discord.com/channels/1500898812942745602/1501005561401970988

5. Will the server close soon/when luna launches/later?
